query: INSERT INTO ops.email_deliveries(message_type,recipient_hash,template_version, object_type,object_id,status,attempt_count) VALUES($1,$2,'v1','publication',$3,'SENDING',1) ON CONFLICT(message_type,object_id,recipient_hash) WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET status=CASE WHEN ops.email_deliveries.status='DELIVERED' THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE 'SENDING' END, attempt_count=CASE WHEN ops.email_deliveries.status='DELIVERED' THEN ops.email_deliveries.attempt_count ELSE ops.email_deliveries.attempt_count+1 END, last_error_code=NULL RETURNING id,status
